description: Persist an external HTTPS image URL, Base64/Data URI image, ChatGPT uploaded/generated file (openaiFileIdRefs), or Claude/vector SVG graphic (svgMarkup rasterized to PNG) into WordFlux R2 storage and Media Library.

caption.description: Optional caption or description for the Media Library

openaiFileIdRefs.description: Array of user-uploaded or AI-generated image files from ChatGPT to save into WordFlux Media Library

svgMarkup.description: SVG XML markup or data:image/svg+xml Data URI (e.g. from Claude Artifacts) to rasterize into a crisp PNG

name: wordflux_upload_media
